fmt.time: Label: how times are written (12-hour or 24-hour). Settings › General row and a Clock right-click submenu. 1 to 3 words.
fmt.date: Label: how dates are written. Settings › General row and a Clock right-click submenu; its choices are today's date in each style. 1 to 3 words.
fmt.default: Time format choice: the language's usual style (Korean and English both show AM/PM). One word.
fmt.follow: Clock right-click choice: use the format chosen in Settings › General instead of this clock's own. Short.
fmt.h12: Time format choice: 12-hour clock with AM/PM. Short.
fmt.h12plain: Time format choice: 12-hour clock without the AM/PM mark (10:27 for 10:27 PM). Short.
